sec.title: September 1 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 543)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 1** across Paul Rhymer's masterwork midwestern domestic comedies, Western frontier lore, speculative audio tapestries, juvenile aviation serial adventures, and university dramatic historical biographies, Bernardine Flynn, Art Van Harvey, and Clarence Hartzell in *Vic and Sade* (1940, 1944), *Death Valley Days* for 20 Mule Team Borax (1939), Michael Hanson on *Mindwebs* (1978), *Hop Harrigan* (1947), and *The American Adventure* (1939–1978):
